catalogWeightedCost.formula: sum(seedCount * measured WASM CPU seconds per day) / populationObjects
catalogWeightedCost.interpretation: Weighted estimate from independently timed resident seeds; catalog totals are serial CPU seconds, not measured full-catalog wall time. Caps were measured in separate runs; paired standard CPU and load averages are retained.
catalogWeightedCost.pairedStandardNormalization: (fast120 / standard measured with 120) / (fast300 / standard measured with 300); both standard runs use unchanged 1e-12 / 300 s settings. This adjusts for timing variation; caps were measured in separate runs.
